node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 exact active-allocation inequality
node.statement: Conditional on the positive-coordinate payment, corrected geometry/orientation assembly, and certified balanced-core allocation definition, print the exact integers U_positive, U_geometry, U_K3=U_positive+U_geometry, and U_K3_allocation, bind each input to its proof certificate and manifest digest, and prove by exact integer arithmetic that U_K3 does not exceed U_K3_allocation. The joint unpaid reserve is not a K3-only allocation. No floating-point comparison, owner renormalization, omitted bridge or line multiplicity, or allocation imported from a different row, cell, or partition is allowed.
node.falsifier: The exact total exceeds the allocation, an input integer lacks a pinned proof certificate, a digest or row differs, or the comparison uses a different owner/normalization convention.
